findings.title: Two comments still say a socket's return is not measured on v14, though LIVE-E04-04 read that connect comes again
findings.what_happens: gm-store.mjs says "Whether v14's socket emits \"connect\" again is LIVE-E04-04" and frisk.mjs "A drop without a reload is not measured on v14, nor whether its socket emits \"connect\" again". On 14.370 game.socket.disconnect() then connect() emitted connect again 10 s later without a reload (LOCAL-REPORT.md:453), and v14 sent no document written meanwhile. The code's listener is right; the comments leave out what was read, and gm-store.mjs's "deltas sent while it was down arrive with the states" is the engine's own exchange, which was not read.
findings.evidence: gm-store.mjs:1743-1745: "// A socket that comes back after a drop re-exchanges: deltas sent while it was down / // arrive with the states. Whether v14's socket emits \"connect\" again is LIVE-E04-04. / game.socket.on(\"connect\", () => engine.sendHello());"
findings.failure_scenario: A contributor deciding whether a GM back from a network drop needs a reload reads these comments as 'unknown' and misses the recorded reading that v14 does not resend the missed documents, which is the half that matters to a stale window.
findings.refutation_tried: The reading is of one road (a console's disconnect, not a real network loss: LOCAL-REPORT.md:453 says the driver's offline mode closed nothing), so 'not measured' is still true of a real drop; kept as a nit for the half that was read. Also seen by live-items-01 item 44, whose note names the same two lines.
